source.title: Open Problems and Conjectures: On third-order rational difference equations, part 2

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 5270203.

Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged for the zbMATH web interface, metadata_only for the available zbMATH OAI resolver record, and paywalled_or_restricted for the publisher landing and full-text pages. The local shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/5270203 returned a Cloudflare challenge rather than source text. The zbMATH OAI record confirmed document_id 5270203, zbl_id 1133.39302, DOI 10.1080/10236190801912308, publication year 2008, and authors Camouzis and Ladas, but did not provide readable technical source text.

Crossref and OpenAlex metadata for DOI 10.1080/10236190801912308 identified the exact work as Open Problems and Conjectures with subtitle On third-order rational difference equations, part 2, Journal of Difference Equations and Applications 14(4), pages 433-458, 2008. This metadata was used only for source identity, title recovery, and bounded recovery, not for question extraction.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier 5270203, DOI 10.1080/10236190801912308, exact title and subtitle, and the authors Camouzis and Ladas. The Taylor & Francis DOI landing and full-text pages exposed metadata and access controls rather than readable full text. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, any_repository_has_fulltext=false, and has_fulltext=false. The Bryant Digital Repository candidate was rejected because it describes a different 2004 Journal of Difference Equations and Applications item, volume 10 issue 12 pages 1119-1127, and states that the document is currently not available there. The ResearchGate candidate was rejected because the public full-text body corresponds to a different source, When does local asymptotic stability imply global attractivity in rational equations?, DOI 10.1080/10236190600772663, not the exact 2008 work.

No candidates were mapped, extracted, rewritten, deduplicated, or accepted because no readable PDF or HTML full-text artifact could be confirmed and accessed as the same exact zbMATH source. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, abstracts, citation pages, search snippets, paywalled pages, or different works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5270203.json and outputs/latest.json.
